```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(scales)

set.seed(26)

# ILLUSTRATIVE (simulated) data: 26 weeks, 4 categories
weeks <- seq(as.Date("2026-01-05"), by = "week", length.out = 26)
cats  <- c("Produce", "Gifts", "Nursery", "Honey and wine")

weekly <- expand.grid(week = weeks, category = cats, stringsAsFactors = FALSE) |>
  as_tibble() |>
  mutate(
    sessions      = round(rnorm(n(), 450, 60) * ifelse(category == "Gifts", 1.3, 1)),
    mismatches    = rpois(n(), ifelse(category == "Nursery", 5, 3)),
    conv_rate     = pmax(0.01, 0.045 - 0.002 * mismatches + rnorm(n(), 0, 0.004)),
    online_orders = round(sessions * conv_rate),
    online_rev    = online_orders * runif(n(), 28, 55),
    pos_rev       = online_rev / runif(n(), 0.08, 0.14)
  )

by_week <- weekly |>
  group_by(week) |>
  summarise(
    conv_rate  = sum(online_orders) / sum(sessions),
    online_rev = sum(online_rev),
    share      = sum(online_rev) / sum(pos_rev),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

## Row {height=18%}

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Online revenue (illustrative)"
list(icon = "cart", color = "#1F3A2E",
     value = dollar(sum(weekly$online_rev), accuracy = 1))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Average conversion rate"
list(icon = "percent", color = "#C48A3A",
     value = percent(sum(weekly$online_orders) / sum(weekly$sessions), accuracy = 0.1))
```

```{r}
#| content: valuebox
#| title: "Mismatched item-weeks"
list(icon = "exclamation-triangle", color = "#8A3B2E",
     value = comma(sum(weekly$mismatches)))
```

## Row {height=37%}

### Column {width=60%}

```{r}
#| title: "Does the conversion rate move over time?"
p <- ggplot(by_week, aes(week, conv_rate)) +
  geom_line(color = "#1F3A2E", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#C48A3A") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 0.1)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Conversion rate") +
  theme_minimal()
ggplotly(p)
```

### Column {width=40%}

```{r}
#| title: "Which categories have the most mismatches?"
cat_mis <- weekly |>
  group_by(category) |>
  summarise(mismatches = sum(mismatches), .groups = "drop")
p2 <- ggplot(cat_mis, aes(reorder(category, mismatches), mismatches)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#C48A3A") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Mismatched item-weeks") +
  theme_minimal()
ggplotly(p2)
```

## Row {height=45%}

```{r}
#| title: "Weekly data (searchable)"
weekly |>
  mutate(conv_rate = round(conv_rate, 3),
         online_rev = round(online_rev),
         pos_rev = round(pos_rev)) |>
  datatable(options = list(pageLength = 8, scrollY = "200px", paging = FALSE), rownames = FALSE)
```
